title: CheckPlan
description: How each check in a workspace is produced. Lives at vibe-checks.yaml in the workspace root. A verifier node's evidence comes from the command declared here, so weakening a check is a tracked diff rather than an argument nobody reviews.

checks.description: Keyed by the check name a graph verifier node writes. A node whose check is absent here cannot advance, which is deliberate: an unconfigured workspace must not be the most permissive one.

checkName.description: Matches the check-name pattern in run-state.schema.json, so a plan cannot declare a name run state would refuse to store.

entry.description: One check. Must say how it is produced: a command, a set of paths, or an explicit human decision.

verifier.description: Overrides the graph node's verifier kind. `human` means no runtime verifier can produce this check and a person decides it, which is the only route by which caller-supplied evidence reaches a verifier node.

command.description: Executable to run. Its exit code is the evidence; output is captured but never parsed for a verdict.

paths.description: For the files verifier. Proves the paths exist and hold something, which is a weaker claim than most checks need.

description.description: For humans reading the plan. The runtime ignores it, and it is the right place to record why a check is declared human.
